rulePolicy: Generic scenes and meanings are fixed before image selection; positive labels require agreement from at least two original human captions. Caption absence is not an explicit negative label. Family groups keep related action/object meanings together. Counts are before photo/split/deduplication filters.

cautions: Caption absence is not proof that an image does not depict a meaning; use as weak relative evidence only.
Some relations or actions may be mentioned in a caption without being visually distinguishable; independently inspect held-out images.
Colour and generic attribute captions may refer to only one object in a busy scene.
Related senses share a family, e.g the object bicycle and riding or parked bicycle.
Object subtypes such as puppy and kitten are separate legitimate vocabulary meanings, grouped with dog and cat respectively.
